def main():

    N = int(input())

    seen = set()
    for i in range(N - 1, -1, -1):
        seen.add(A[i])
        suffix_distinct[i] = len(seen)

    ans = 0
    seen.clear()

        seen.add(A[i])

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
